card.text: Explore Juno in 3D with its published VLT/SPHERE shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Juno is an irregular main-belt asteroid with broad departures from an ellipsoid. This model combines light-curve constraints with resolved VLT/SPHERE observations. Explore its published shape and radial heights. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: SPHERE shape reconstruction
shape.summary: Shape made from VLT/SPHERE observations. Gray grid: no surface imagery; lighting shows the model's form.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Distance above or below a reference sphere. Colors include the body's shape as well as local terrain.
